explanation: Its name is Latin for 'nearest'. A faint red dwarf about 4.2 light years away, it is too dim to see with the naked eye, unlike its partners Alpha Centauri A and B.

claims.text: After the Sun, the star closest to Earth is Proxima Centauri.
Alpha Centauri A, Sirius and Polaris are all further from Earth than Proxima Centauri.
Proxima comes from the Latin for 'nearest'.
Proxima Centauri is about 4.2 light years from Earth.
Proxima Centauri is a red dwarf too faint to see with the naked eye, while Alpha Centauri A and B are easily visible.
